name: BACH_0315
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (63%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
- Tier 3 flag: 90% conformal set spans Normal and Benign, with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 63%, Benign 30%, InSitu 7%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) | Low invasive risk; benign differential |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 38th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] (70% AUROC) | Typical, reliable biopsy image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (88%–93%) [F5]; Benign contrast 88% | Nearest references all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.981) [F2], 0/20 spot check (unreliable) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.904) [F3], 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.234) [F4], 0/20 spot check (unreliable) · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Score +0.207, 8/20 spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score vs random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- A benign lesion is present (Benign 30%; contrast case BACH_0202 is 88% similar).
- Focal atypia (InSitu 7%) is missed; HoVer-Net flagged insufficient tumor nuclei (3 counted).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 11**: Highest risk scores (0.019, 0.004, 0.003); region 3 has 2 neoplastic and 3 dead nuclei.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 8, 9**: Verify benign stroma/lobules (3, 4, 8), 1 neoplastic nucleus (8), and duct atypia/TILs (9).
